checks.reason: The only subclass in main or test code is the static anonymous CACHE in FastDateFormat. It captures no state, and its createInstance just calls new FastDateFormat(pattern, timeZone, locale), so a concrete cache that builds FastDateFormat directly (or takes a factory function) would lose nothing; the class is package-private, tests use only its static members, and the 'Before making public' TODO marks the generality as speculative rather than a documented extension point.

Only FastDateFormat's anonymous subclass overrides createInstance, so it is single-implementation in fact, but it is a template-method cache with substantial shared logic and static helpers used by other classes and tests; folding it in is possible but arguable.
